name: CoupleWatchingVolleyball

custom.system_prompt: Maja and Rafael are watching a volleyball match at home — either the Polish national team in a tournament or a major European club match. Maja is passionate and knowledgeable about the sport; Rafael has learned enough to follow it well. They react to plays, discuss tactics, and talk about personal topics during set breaks. Sigma is addressed exactly once to resolve a question about a player's previous club.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room in the evening, volleyball match on television in the background, arena crowd noise, commentator reactions to rallies and serves, occasional excited crowd burst after a point, natural domestic sounds.

initial_prompt: Generate a lively, natural conversation between Maja and Rafael watching a volleyball match at home. Maja is an ex-club player who follows the Polish national team intensely; Rafael has become a genuine fan through her. They react to rallies, serves, and tactical decisions. During set breaks they talk about personal topics: life in London, their families back home, a plan they need to make. A player on the opposing team catches Maja's attention — she is certain she knows this player from a previous Italian or Turkish club, but Rafael thinks it was somewhere else. They debate between sets. Maja nearly has it. The question resurfaces when the player has a standout rally. They reconstruct what they know: the approximate season, the club's city, a tournament they followed. Eventually one of them asks Sigma which club the player transferred from. Sigma answers in one sentence. They react and return to the match. Sigma is not addressed again.

user1.name: Maja
user1.tts_prompt: Energetic, passionate about volleyball, Polish accent, occasionally switches into Polish when excited

user2.name: Rafael
user2.tts_prompt: Warm, engaged fan, Brazilian-accented English, enjoys learning from Maja

variations.context: A couple watching a major volleyball match — Polish national team or European club volleyball. Maja is the expert; Rafael is the engaged learner.

setting.mood: Energetic during rallies, relaxed and conversational during set breaks. Maja is emotionally invested; Rafael enjoys following her lead and contributing his own reads.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Maja played club volleyball and knows the European circuit well — clubs, transfers, national teams. Rafael follows it enough to comment on tactics. They have complementary knowledge and enjoy the gap.
setting.background: The match is in progress — second or third set. They have already watched the first set together.
setting.conversation_style: Short, reactive turns during rallies; longer personal conversations during set breaks. The player question comes up between sets and recurs.

scenario_template.topic: They are watching the second or third set. Reactions to the current score, a serve, a defensive play. Maja comments on team tactics.
During a set break, they move to a personal topic: life in London, plans to visit family in Poland or Brazil, something that happened during the week.
scenario_template.note: This should feel like a natural gear-shift during the pause.

scenario_template.topic: A player on the opposing team makes a standout play. Maja is sure she knows this player from a previous club — Italian league, Turkish league, or Champions League. Rafael remembers a different club. They debate.
scenario_template.note: Non-trigger moment. No Sigma.

scenario_template.topic: The next set starts. The player question is dropped. Rally-by-rally reactions.
Another set break. A second personal topic: a friend they should visit, Maja's nostalgia about playing club volleyball, or their plans for the summer.
scenario_template.note: Maja's playing past can surface naturally here.

scenario_template.topic: The player has a standout rally that brings the question back. Maja narrows it to two clubs; Rafael thinks he saw the player in a different competition entirely. They discuss the approximate season, the club's country.
Maja reconstructs what she knows: the club colours, the city, a tournament she followed that year. She is nearly certain but not quite. Rafael offers a guess that doesn't fit.
Maja or Rafael asks Sigma which club the player transferred from.
scenario_template.note: Exactly one request and one response. Sigma names the previous club and approximate season. One sentence.

scenario_template.topic: Analyzing team formations and strategies
scenario_template.note: They dive into a brief analysis of the team's formation and discuss potential strategy changes.

scenario_template.topic: Casual chat about dinner plans
scenario_template.note: They momentarily shift focus to decide whether to order pizza or cook after the match.

scenario_template.topic: Rafael recalls a volleyball anecdote
scenario_template.note: Rafael shares a funny story from the first time he watched a live volleyball match.

scenario_template.topic: Noticing fans in the stands
scenario_template.note: They comment on the antics of a particularly animated fan in the crowd, adding levity to the break.

scenario_template.topic: Speculating on a coaching strategy
scenario_template.note: Maja offers insight into why the coach might be rotating players more frequently, and Rafael asks questions to understand the implications.

scenario_template.topic: Chat with a fellow spectator online
scenario_template.note: Rafael mentions an online chat with another fan who's watching the game, sharing funny comments or insights.

scenario_template.topic: They react — Maja's satisfaction or mild surprise, Rafael's acceptance. Return to the match.
scenario_template.note: Sigma is not addressed again.

assistant_trigger_design.latent_need: Maja recognises a volleyball player from a previous club but cannot confirm the exact club from memory.
assistant_trigger_design.early_non_trigger: The first recognition moment must not lead to Sigma. Fans debate transfer history routinely.
activation_evidence: The player makes a standout play that brings the question back.
Both people have proposed specific but conflicting clubs.
Maja has reconstructed partial details — country, approximate season — without confirming.
assistant_trigger_design.desired_response: The player's previous club and approximate transfer season in one sentence.
undesired_behavior: Sigma responding to the first recognition remark.
Sigma providing full career statistics or national team record.
Sigma commenting on the current match.

possible_sigma_queries: Sigma, which club was she at before this?
Sigma, where did he transfer from?
Sigma, what was his club before the national team?
Sigma, which Italian club was she at?
Sigma, where did he play in the Champions League last year?
possible_sigma_answers: She transferred from Imoco Volley Conegliano in 2022.
He played for Ziraat Bankası Ankara before joining this club.
She was at Igor Gorgonzola Novara until last season.
He transferred from Trentino Volley two summers ago.
She was at VakıfBank Istanbul before this season.
